<title level="1" right="Spell 2" pfs="Standard">
[Gentle Breeze](/Spells.aspx?ID=1316)
<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Air" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=5" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Healing" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=89" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Vitality" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=509" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 70

**Traditions**
[Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 60 feet

**Area** 40-foot burst

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 10 minutes
</row>

</column>

---

A light, soothing breeze flows through the area, making it easier to rest and recover. [Medicine](/Skills.aspx?ID=9) checks attempted to benefit living creatures in the area get a +2 status bonus. Any living creature in the area also gets a +2 status bonus to saving throws against afflictions and, if it remains within the area for the full duration, regains 10 Hit Points. In addition, the cool breeze reduces the [temperature effects of heat](/Rules.aspx?ID=642) by one step for any creature in the area.

---
**Heightened (+2)** The healing increases by 10 Hit Points.
name: Gentle Breeze
